notes: Extracted 29 October 2026 from the guide (src/guides/form.guide.tsx) and docs/evidence/form.md at 8572e95 on docs-next (“docs: publish the 5 October Coin build's component fixes”, #186/#187), which the copy snapshot records. The live guide on main is older: Documentation #55 was approved at 5c62248 and published to main as 51f6153 on 8 October, and 8572e95's Form part never reached main. The two differ only in the Configuration card (docs-next “Other fields too” / “Form Upload and Message Field show their errors the same way.”, main “Form Upload too” / “Form Upload shows its error the same way.”), the Sources note's checked date and body, and the evidence's “636f3f5 check” section (docs-next only). So that the entry is true of the live guide, every item quotes only a sentence identical in both: nothing quotes that card, the Sources note or the 636f3f5 section; they were read only to understand the installed behaviour. Evidence items quote the 7 October Check, Browser measurements and Coin gaps sections (0.1.78-3795b4c, identical on both branches). Installed build: jfs-components 0.1.78, mirror v0.1.78-dbe0e02 (Biscuit's main at dbe0e02, 27 October). GitHub's compare of the mirror tags shows Form.tsx and FormField.tsx changed after 636f3f5 (MessageField and FormUpload did not), and FormField's layout is unchanged since 3795b4c (only aria attributes and Enter handling). Every sentence used was checked against the installed source, read, not run: Form renders one View with form/gap 12 and form/padding 0 (single-mode tokens) and no background (Form.tsx:229-237, 255-269); only FormField, FormUpload and MessageField call useFormContext, each reads validationErrors[name] only with a name, shows a list's first string, and lets its own errorMessage win (FormField.tsx:335-339, FormUpload.tsx:168-171, MessageField.tsx:289-291 and 518-521); TextInput never reads the Form; typing (or adding or removing a file) calls onFieldChange, which clears that key only (Form.tsx:218-222; FormField.tsx:425-430; FormUpload.tsx:209, 221); a label-only Form Field is the 17 px label, 8 px gap and the 47 px measured row (72), plus 8 px and the 16 px support line with a message (96). “When the screen sends a new set of errors, they all show again” holds as dbe0e02 now implements re-validation (Form.tsx:51-64, 114-167): cleared errors return when the screen replaces an errors object a later render had already passed again (errors kept in state, as the guide's In context does) or when that field's message changes; a stream of new objects with the same messages (an inline literal re-rendered) no longer brings them back. Stale on the installed build and therefore not used: the Sources note's “its onSubmit property does nothing” (both versions; Form now calls onSubmit on Enter on the web and when a Form Field submits, Form.tsx:169-204, 243-265, FormField.tsx:433-437, 646); main's “In this version Message Field turns red but shows no message” (#187 fixed, MessageField.tsx:289-291, 518-521, 572); main's “errors are not announced” and both versions' “the form has no accessible name” (FormField and MessageField set aria-invalid and aria-describedby; with an accessibilityLabel the root is role form, named by it, Form.tsx:239-261; nothing announces errors when they arrive); the evidence's onSubmit “never used”, no submit or Enter handling, “When the validationErrors object changes, every error shows again”, MessageField “shows no message”, the inline-object line, the aria line and those #207 points. Accessibility is left empty: the guide states accessibility only in its Sources note, which differs between the branches and is partly stale; screen-reader naming and announcements are not gaps in this pack. Not recorded: onSubmit, accessibilityLabel, style and testID (the guide covers them only in Sources), the Configuration card that differs (Form Upload and Message Field in a Form), the playground, and the status readout. avoidWhen rests on the evidence's record of the upstream Storybook mdx (3795b4c; the mirror ships no mdx, so it was not re-read) and is advice the installed source does not contradict; it carries no useInstead, since the mdx names none. Gaps are the #207 points still open on dbe0e02: no error summary, and the stale published Storybook (re-checked 29 October: its index.json still lists only Default, With Validation Errors, Server Validation and the docs page); #186 and #187 are fixed and not gaps. Examples follow the building rules: no Color Mode and no other modes (the guide sets modes={LIGHT} on every Form, FormField, Card, VStack and Button); the guide's docs wrappers (Surface, the width 100% VStack), testIDs and the status paragraph are left out; Card, VStack, FormField and Button have entries; Verify account keeps its defaults (the main action) outside the Form. Copy and values are the guide's own (the In context errors are what its check gives with the account number and IFSC code empty); errors are inline literals for the snippet, where the guide keeps them in constants or state; handlers are stubs. The guide's lone-field examples (PAN list, Email) are not used as examples, since the avoidWhen advises against a lone field in a Form; the list behaviour is a configuration rule.

examples.purpose: Checking bank details, the guide's In context: a Card holds the Form and the Verify account Button, which sits outside the Form and stays enabled. Shown after people tapped Verify account with the account number and IFSC code empty: the screen's check passed these errors, keyed by the fields' names, and each named field shows its own. Editing a field clears its message. The inline errors and the onChangeText and onPress stubs stand in for the screen's own state and check.
examples.jsx:
<Card>
  <VStack>
    <Form validationErrors={{ account: 'Account numbers have 9 to 18 digits', ifsc: 'IFSC codes have 11 characters' }}>
      <FormField name="holder" label="Account holder name" value="Asha Rao" onChangeText={() => {}} />
      <FormField name="account" type="number" label="Account number" value="" onChangeText={() => {}} />
      <FormField name="ifsc" label="IFSC code" value="" onChangeText={() => {}} />
    </Form>
    <Button label="Verify account" onPress={() => {}} />
  </VStack>
</Card>
